svg.title: Selected output from agent-cli --help
svg.desc: Actual command help captured in a terminal, typeset with three explanatory annotations: select the model and working directory, choose the rendering mode, and control tool approvals.

g.text: --model NAME Override the saved last model
--cwd DIR Working directory for tools (default: current)
--worktree Create a new git worktree under ~/.haskell-agent/worktrees
--yolo Auto-approve tools; computer use asks separately
--no-yolo Never auto-approve; deny mutating tools without a TTY
1. Select the model and checkout before giving the agent a task.
2. Choose fullscreen interaction or terminal-native output.
3. Choose the approval policy deliberately; these flags have different effects.
Selected terminal output, re-typeset with annotations. Not an interactive-session screenshot.
Run agent-cli --help for the full reference supplied by your installed version.
